comments.body:
Duplicate/RCA disposition before close.

Step 0(a): tracker sweep for `dict(os.environ) pytest fixture secrets environment leak` found closed canonical sibling ticket `dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran` with the same title, same seven fixture surfaces, same plan, and same acceptance criteria as this ticket. Step 0(b): no report version in this duplicate; using created_at floor gives origin/main floor a22257e7d10e3d079ee676cbb38d2b39811d0fd5, with no later changes to the seven suspect fixture files. Step 0(c): worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/credleak-fixtures` at e768151d680f7295bfd37424cec31946b88d0ab8 (= origin/main).

Proven root cause: this ticket is not a new live defect. It is a duplicate of already-landed `dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran`: prior RCA showed seven decorated fixtures copied the complete insertion-ordered `os.environ` into values rendered by pytest on unrelated failures. Current origin/main follows the established fix pattern: each fixture now builds an explicit mutable allowlist instead of copying arbitrary ambient keys (`tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_materialize_probe.py:91`, `test_autodeploy_fetch_secrets.py:102`, `test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py:123`, `test_autodeploy_health_gate.py:118`, `test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py:106`, `test_observability_exit.py:69`, `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py:58`).

Proof/replication: focused minimal-parent run over both sentinel-rendering security tests and all affected fixture consumers returned `72 passed, 1 skipped in 97.73s` using `env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin "$PWD/.venv/bin/python" -m pytest -q ...`. The original long-trace sentinel leak no longer reproduces. Construct sweep: an AST scan of all `tests/**/*.py` found no `@pytest.fixture` returning `dict(os.environ)`, `os.environ.copy()`, or a nested alias to either; `test_autodeploy_materialize_certbot.py::_make_box` remains outside scope as a plain helper per the canonical RCA, and broader subprocess-env carrier work remains on `antiutopic-toadyish-goldfinch`.

Defect origin/Gerrit: canonical fix is Gerrit Change 1851, commit aa41c2e45ad10da6296f6b642d0eed9e9ba76d6e, reachable from origin/main with trailer `rebar-ticket: 3402-7143-2e14-4d1a`; prior ticket records LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, and merged CI run 32111971923. Because this ticket is a duplicate rather than an independent defect fix, the durable origin is the `duplicates` edge to `dumbstruck-wonderful-xiphosuran`, not a new `caused_by` edge.

## Context
The RCA for broadish-permanent-condor found seven additional `@pytest.fixture` functions that return a full `dict(os.environ)` directly or nested inside the fixture argument pytest renders. Default long tracebacks can print early ambient credentials through `saferepr`. Confirmed fixtures: `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_materialize_probe.py`, `test_autodeploy_fetch_secrets.py`, `test_autodeploy_disk_pressure.py`, `test_autodeploy_health_gate.py`, `test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config.py`, `test_observability_exit.py`, and `tests/interfaces/facades/test_cli.py`.

The scope boundary is the decorated pytest-fixture return path. An AST sweep found no eighth fixture. In particular, `test_autodeploy_materialize_certbot.py::_make_box` is a plain helper whose result is assigned to a test local, so an unrelated later assertion does not render it as a fixture argument; a runtime long/short traceback probe confirmed the sentinel stays absent. A distinct exception-time carrier exists for 103 test-local subprocess mappings when the subprocess call itself raises; follow-up `antiutopic-toadyish-goldfinch` owns that larger audit. Runtime/maintenance environment propagation is excluded because preserving caller credentials/config is a separate product contract.

## Plan
- Build a parametrized real-pytest RED oracle using insertion-ordered synthetic sentinels and deterministic unrelated failures for each of the seven decorated fixture surfaces.
- Replace each broad ambient copy with an explicit mutable allowlist: fake-bin-first `PATH` plus that harness's declared variables and per-test overrides. This is preferred over a representation wrapper because the subprocess contract itself should be explicit, the 24-test minimal-parent-environment run proves arbitrary keys are unnecessary, and it avoids adding a shared abstraction solely for test fixtures.
- Prove sentinel absence under default long traceback and preserve the short-traceback negative control.
- Run every existing fixture consumer under the minimal parent environment and the normal focused suites.
- Reintroduce the exact broad-copy mutation and require the oracle to return to RED.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Each of the seven decorated fixtures has a deterministic RED failure-rendering probe.
- [x] No decorated fixture in the AST construct sweep returns arbitrary ambient values.
- [x] Default long traceback output contains no synthetic ambient sentinel on any of the seven surfaces.
- [x] The fake-bin-first `PATH` remains available to every existing fixture consumer.
- [x] Explicit harness environment variables remain mutable by their existing tests.
- [x] [operator-attested] The 24-test minimal-parent-environment suite passes.
  provenance: environment=minimal-parent-worktree-aa41c2e45a; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=simulation — 42-pass real pytest fixture/subprocess run under env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin
- [x] [operator-attested] Focused suites pass.
  provenance: environment=minimal-parent-worktree-aa41c2e45a; principal=RebarBotNava; privilege_posture=narrower; instrument=simulation — affected real fixture consumers plus held-out rendering oracle
- [x] [operator-attested] Lint passes.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-ci-run-32111971923; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — canonical gating Ruff, formatting, and repository policy checks
- [x] [operator-attested] Typecheck passes.
  provenance: environment=gerrit-ci-run-32111971923; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=static-analysis — canonical gating mypy run
- [x] The exact broad-copy mutation returns the security oracle to RED.
